details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate). Please name it in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation only (README.md, agents.md, docs/)
C. A specific script or prompt under scripts/ or prompts/. Please name it in your answer.
D. None. This issue was opened by mistake or as a test and should be closed.
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you saw. Please give a run link, error text or steps to reproduce. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Lower cost or runtime (fewer API calls, tokens or minutes)
C. Add a new capability or behaviour. Please describe it.
D. Make docs or log output clearer
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete check you will state, such as a test passing, an error no longer appearing, or a metric reaching a threshold. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A reviewer's judgement on the PR, with no objective criterion
